hero.title: Welcome to DishDash
hero.subtitle: Your smart kitchen assistant for effortless meal planning, recipe management, and grocery shopping

whatIsDishDash.title: What is DishDash?
paragraphs: DishDash is a comprehensive meal planning solution designed to make your kitchen life easier and more organized. It helps you track ingredients, discover recipes, plan weekly menus, and generate smart shopping lists—all in one place.
Say goodbye to food waste, forgotten ingredients, and the daily "what's for dinner?" stress. DishDash brings calm and organization to your meal planning routine.

features.title: Ingredient Management
features.description: Track your pantry inventory with shelf life monitoring. Color-coded alerts help you use ingredients before they expire.

features.title: Recipe Library
features.description: Store and organize your favorite recipes. Search by ingredients, cuisine, or dietary preferences. Mark favorites for quick access.

features.title: Favorites Collection
features.description: Save your most-loved recipes to a dedicated favorites list. Quick access to the meals you cook most often.

features.title: Smart Shopping List
features.description: Automatically generate shopping lists from your menu. Check off items as you shop and never forget an ingredient again.

steps.title: Add Your Ingredients
steps.description: Start by adding ingredients to your pantry. Set shelf life for perishables to track freshness. The app will alert you when items are about to expire with color-coded borders.

steps.title: Build Your Recipe Collection
steps.description: Add your favorite recipes with ingredients, instructions, prep time, and cooking time. Use filters to search by cuisine type, dietary preferences, or specific ingredients you want to use.

steps.title: Mark Your Favorites
steps.description: As you explore recipes, save your favorites with a single click. All your go-to meals are organized in one place for quick access when planning your week.

steps.title: Build Your Shopping List
steps.description: Select a recipe and automatically add all missing ingredients to your shopping list. Check off items as you shop, and add custom items as needed. Your shopping is now organized and stress-free.

benefits.text: Reduce food waste by tracking shelf life
Save time with automated menu planning
Never forget ingredients at the store
Organize recipes in one convenient place
